scope: Claim-to-evidence map for the submitted manuscript.

claims.claim: RecurrentShield-BC has 4.0% clean-FPR on US-101 P3 and 0.0% on I-80/Lankershim.
claims.limitation: In-domain calibration and fresh-period domain shift are not interchangeable.

claims.claim: Direct Raw Norm outperforms RecurrentShield-BC on fresh-period clean-FPR.
claims.limitation: The recurrent detector has 100.0% I-80 post-onset recall versus 91.7% for Raw Norm, so no single detector dominates every metric.

claims.claim: The DT-CBF theorem is conditional on assumptions A1-A5 and on feasible substeps.
claims.limitation: The proof does not establish continuous-time safety or real-vehicle safety.

claims.claim: The 200 Hz CBF interval is numerical substep verification, not 200 Hz actuation.
claims.limitation: The outer policy/control cycle remains 10 Hz.

claims.claim: In the selected BLOS22 replay, quarantine preserves 37.9 m versus 24.9 m without IDS filtering.
claims.limitation: Single initial speed, queue distance, radar range, and ten repeated trials do not establish broad operational prevalence.

claims.claim: ESP32-S3 cycle, latency, and energy values are analytical projections.
claims.limitation: Only serialized weight size and host CPU timing are measured.
